course_description: A comprehensive 10-week journey from AI fundamentals to building advanced multi-agent systems - no coding background required to start.
target_audience: Total beginners, career changers, students, small business owners, and curious professionals in any field

phases.title: Phase 1: AI Literacy & Foundations
phases.summary: Master the terminology and core concepts of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning using everyday, relatable examples.

phases.title: Phase 2: Mastering Prompt Engineering
phases.summary: Learn the art and science of communicating with Large Language Models using industry-standard patterns and advanced prompting techniques.

phases.title: Phase 3: AI-Driven Automation & Everyday Systems
phases.summary: Integrate AI into your daily life and work using beginner-friendly Python, automation tools, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

phases.title: Phase 4: Real-World Implementation
phases.summary: Apply everything you've learned to build a working AI solution for a real problem in your own life, studies, or work.

phases.title: Phase 5: Professional AI Fluency & Solutions
phases.summary: Master the skills employers and everyday life demand: build 20+ real-world solutions and boost your personal and professional productivity with genuine AI fluency.
